sections.section_name: Section A - Choose the Correct Answer

questions.question_text: Which of these is a percussion instrument?
What do we call a story told through dance without speaking?
Which facial expression shows happiness in a dance?
How do you make a sound with a flute?
When a dancer moves very fast, the music is usually:
Which body part is mostly used for tapping a rhythm?
What is a group of people singing together called?
Which instrument makes sound when its strings are plucked?
Mudras in Indian dance are mostly done using which body part?
Which of these sounds is natural and not made by an instrument?
Name two different ways to make sound using your body. [20-30 words]
questions.answer: You can make sound by clapping your hands loudly together. You can also make sound by stomping your feet hard on the ground to create a heavy beat.

questions.question_text: Describe how a slow, sad song makes you feel and act. [20-30 words]
questions.answer: A slow, sad song makes me feel sleepy and quiet. It makes me want to sit still, drop my shoulders, and sway slowly to the gentle music.

questions.question_text: What happens when a dancer changes their facial expression from angry to surprised? [20-30 words]
questions.answer: The dancer stops frowning and glaring. Instead, they open their eyes very wide, lift their eyebrows high, and open their mouth slightly to show sudden surprise.

questions.question_text: How does a drum sound different from a small bell? [20-30 words]
questions.answer: A drum makes a loud, deep, and heavy booming sound. A small bell makes a high, sweet, and light tinkling sound that rings quickly in the air.

questions.question_text: Why is it important to listen to the beat before dancing? [20-30 words]
questions.answer: Listening to the beat helps the dancer match their steps with the music. It ensures their movements are in perfect time, making the dance look smooth and rhythmic.

questions.question_text: Imagine you are creating a dance about a thunderstorm. Describe the sounds and movements you would use. [40-50 words]
questions.answer: I would use heavy drums to sound like loud thunder crashes. I would stomp my feet quickly and wave my arms wildly to show the blowing wind. I would also snap my fingers fast to sound like heavy raindrops falling all around me.

questions.question_text: Imagine a magical guitar that changes color when played. Describe what happens when you play a happy tune on it. [40-50 words]
questions.answer: When I play a happy tune, the magical guitar glows brightly with sunshine yellow and bright pink colors. The strings sparkle like gold, and little musical notes made of light float up into the air, making everyone in the room want to smile and dance.

questions.question_text: How would you use your body, face, and voice to act like a proud king entering a grand hall? [50-60 words]
questions.answer: I would stand up very straight and push my chest out to look important. I would walk with slow, heavy, and firm steps. My face would have a serious, confident look with my chin raised high. I would speak in a loud, deep voice so everyone in the grand hall could hear me clearly.

questions.question_text: Describe a dance sequence where you pretend to be a seed growing into a big tree. [50-60 words]
questions.answer: I would start by curling up tightly on the floor like a tiny seed. Slowly, I would reach one hand up to show a little green shoot growing. Then, I would stand up slowly, stretching my arms wide towards the sky like branches, swaying gently from side to side as if moving in the warm wind.
